title: Compiled replay toggle/modal on B7: scripted BASE vs COMP vs COMP+CR, one-binary decomposition and E3

advances.E2: one-binary decomposition, on B7 with full phase and transport marks, of the composed configuration that includes compiled replay (warm admitted COMP+CR = the warm path of the live toggle/modal COMP+CR configuration: 0 chooser calls)
advances.E3: scripted BASE vs COMP+CR S on one binary for toggle and modal, with training/compile/admission/fallback cost amortized over all invocations
advances.E1: re-confirms toggle CR non-regression on B7 (and measures modal)

hypothesis.H_CR: on B7, warm COMP+CR (compiled fresh-bound replay of an admitted artifact, a fresh semantic_v2 observation per click, 0 decisions) is not slower than COMP (R2-10 scripted step loop) for toggle and modal
hypothesis.H_D: every component of the COMP+CR whole-task T with a share >= 5% or >= 50 ms already has a terminal verdict (B-02/B-04/B-05/B-07/B-08/R2-07e), so the untested share is < 5%

binary.name: cua-driver-b07-231f6e8bb
binary.checks: re-hashed at lane start and end on the host (under hostless) and inside the session; the runner refuses on any mismatch and writes name/sha256/version into every trial record (control and COMP-arm records included) and every manifest

arms.BASE: R2-10 BASE (rb10.one, arm BASE): feedback on (cursor enabled, default motion), no guard, 100 ms completion poll, library MCP output validation, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable; scripted chooser decides each click; phase trace on
arms.COMP: R2-10 scripted COMP step loop (r2_07c.one_comp -> rb10.one, arm COMP): feedback off, 10 ms completion poll, compiled validators, CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1, phase trace on, scripted chooser, telemetry off, no provider key
arms.CRa: COMP + compiled fresh-bound replay of the admitted artifact (r2_07c.one_c, kind warm): fresh semantic_v2 observation before every click, 0 decisions; a failed precondition hands the current state to the guarded continuation, whose scripted decisions are counted
arms.PC: CRa + a 15.0 ms CLOCK_MONOTONIC sleep inside T right after snapshot1 returns (positive control)

per_trial: fresh cua-driver mcp, fresh Driver-launched Chrome (isolated_new, sandbox on), fresh loopback fixture servers, token and session label (cold C arm in every arm); B-07 stamped stdio client, default variant, in every arm
training: before round 0, under the EXCLUSIVE lock: per class one scripted training invocation (R2-10 COMP step loop) + compile (compile_trace_tm, timed) + clean-reset admission replay (no fallback) into the lane-local store 'timed-f'; authority scan (check_artifact_authority_tm) on every artifact. Logical routine identity persists across processes; refs, tokens, captures, capabilities and session epochs never persist. A class whose training does not admit gets NOT_RUN warm arms (no retraining in the measured block)

design.williams: 5 arms, 10 sequences = run_critpath.williams(5) rows plus each row reversed (every arm in every position twice; every ordered pair adjacent twice); arm index order BASE, COMP, CRa, CRb, PC
design.rounds: 40 rounds per class; round r runs, per class, sequence (r + class index) mod 10 (toggle index 0, modal 1); class order toggle->modal on even r, modal->toggle on odd r; every contrast has 40 within-round pairs per class
design.unit: a round (10 trials) is the gating and resume unit; a round started but not completed is kept in raw/ and re-run under an attempt suffix; the analysis uses, per round, the first attempt listed as completed in a run manifest
design.chunks: EXCLUSIVE bin/quiet-timed r207f-<chunk>; the cargo-build lock is checked free before acquiring (busy -> nothing runs, exit 74) and taken inside with flock -w 60; timeout 900; no new round after the chunk budget (exit 76)

load_rule: a round (or training / fallback unit) starts only when the 1-min loadavg is <= 4.0 (1 s polls, <= 60 s wait, else the chunk ends with exit 75 and the same units resume later); loadavg recorded before and after every trial; every trial kept
oracle: kvnloo/cua#24 pages via the jev-use fixture server (toggle checked, modal action applied) and its CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal: exactly one completion mutation. PRIMARY T_runner = R2-10 T (snapshot1 send -> verified oracle read, B.decompose on the R2-10 mark view). SECONDARY T_oracle (2 ms independent sampler, first expected-state sample at/after the caller return of the last accepted mutation, minus snapshot1 send) and T_j = max(journal completion ts, caller return of the last accepted mutation) - snapshot1 send
validity: BASE/COMP: R2-10 browser_row valid (verified, exact oracle, 1 completion mutation, T_oracle defined, forced path dom_event clicks with click.cdp_send, arm configuration receipts); CRa/CRb/PC: R2-07c row_of valid (warm: verified, 2 browser_click, routes == [compiled], 0 decisions, 0 provider requests); plus, every arm: Driver identity == B7, B-07 caller stamps present, all E4 counters 0 (incl. non-loopback connects), and PC: the sleep measured and placed after snapshot1 returns and before the next Driver call. Rows are computed on the R2-10 mark view of the B7 trace (b05_spans.r210_view). Invalid cells stay in every denominator
statistics: paired within-round differences (arm a - arm b) of T_runner; median; percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fresh random.Random(20261003) per contrast, 95% CI = sorted resample medians [249], [9749]. S = median(BASE)/median(CRa) over the valid pairs with the same paired bootstrap (resample rounds, ratio of medians)

gates.G0: validity >= 95% per arm per class AND every valid trial in a class has the same final oracle state (identical outcomes). Invalid cells stay in the denominator
gates.G1_NC: CRa - CRb: 95% CI contains 0 AND |median| <= 1.5 ms
gates.G3: CR warm invocations (CRa, CRb, PC): decisions = 0, fallbacks = 0, provider attempts = 0 and every measured chunk ran with provider_mode mock (no provider ledger)
gates.G4: E4 = 0 in every arm, the training/admission, fallback and control trials (stale dispatch, duplicate mutation, unverified success, refusal returned as success, blind replay, dispatch after unknown, ambiguous dispatch, non-loopback connect)
gates.H_CR: PASS iff CRa - COMP has a paired 95% CI upper bound <= +2.0 ms (R2-07d's pre-registered margin) AND all 40 pairs ran (both cells present in all 40 rounds); per class
gates.S_E3: S_E3 = median T(BASE) / median T(CRa) with CI over the valid pairs; must have CI lower > 1. Reported with S_BASE_over_COMP for reference
gates.amortized: per class: (training T_runner + compile_ms + admission T_runner + the 40 CRa warm T_runner + the 3 forced-fallback T_runner) / 45 invocations, reported separately from the warm median; descriptive mean(BASE)/amortized mean

decomposition.class: BENCHMARK analysis of this lane's own valid CRa trials per class (primary) and COMP trials (reference), binary B7
decomposition.T: R2-10 T_runner per trial; rows with B-05 coverage < 0.98 excluded and counted
decomposition.method: B-08 Part E unchanged in substance: R2-10 e2_components (b08/harness/r2-10r/analyze_r2_10.py on the R2-10 mark view) plus the B-05/B-07 transport sub-spans (b08/harness/b05/b05_spans.decompose_b05) with B-07's units; per-trial consistency = max |sum of sub-spans per component - R2-10 component|
decomposition.views: PRIMARY corrected at c_m = median of this lane's in-situ null-pair intervals over the decomposed CRa and COMP trials (every interval that starts at a Driver mark minus c_m; T_runner_corr = T_runner - marks x c_m); SECONDARY raw

cold_split.rule: E = span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) per trial (b04_rows snap_measures), mean per arm, inside observation. Every arm here is a fresh process (B-08's C), so the per-document part is carried from B-08's warm arm on the same binary: per_document = min(B-08 mean E(Wa), this lane's mean E), IRREDUCIBLE (B-04); per_process = max(0, mean E - per_document), OWNER_DECISION (B-08); the rest of observation IRREDUCIBLE (B-04). The split moves ms only between IRREDUCIBLE and OWNER_DECISION, so it cannot change the untested share

decomposition.untested_share: untested ms / mean T_runner (view) with BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and as UNTESTED
decomposition.list: every R2-10 component, cold split part and lane-scope unit with mean >= 5% of mean T or >= 50 ms, with its verdict and source lane; any component without a verdict is listed as UNTESTED, never relabelled
decomposition.H_D: PASS per class iff, on CRa in the primary (corrected) view, the untested share is < 5% in BOTH BELOW_GATE views AND no listed component or unit has an UNTESTED verdict

cold per-document: B-04 (SOURCE carry of B-08 mean E(Wa) on B7)
cold per-process: B-08 (B7: toggle D 3.05 [2.62, 5.38] ms, modal D 4.56 [2.98, 5.92] ms; OWNER_DECISION)
provider_decision: R2-07e Part L (warm admitted COMP+CR: 0 decisions, 0 provider lines, 29/29 per class; LIVE_PROVIDER, binary R) + this lane G3 (warm decisions 0 on B7)

c_in.prep: B-07 (PREP_FAST KILL on toggle/modal; fill's fragile DELETED is not carried)
res.frame_proof: B-07 (invariant: Page.getFrameTree re-proves the ref's frame identity)
res.editable_check: B-07 (invariant: non-editable targets refused before typing)

controls.lock: SHARED quiet-lane lock, after the measured block (the forced fallbacks run EXCLUSIVE so their T can enter the amortized mean)

rows.N4a: stale ref refused (browser_ref_stale, effect=refused), then one rebind, verified, 1 completion; 2 per class
rows.N4b: superseding snapshot: non-fresh dispatch refused (effect=refused), rebind, verified; 2 per class
rows.N5: session replaced: old capability refused in the new session, fresh bind, verified; 2 per class
rows.N8: wrong page (toggle on fill, toggle on modal, modal on toggle): 0 accepted mutations; 2 per row
rows.N-W2: FIX-01 detached-node refusal (run_b02.control_one): stale action effect=refused browser_ref_stale, 0 mutations from it, re-derived action verified; 2 per class
rows.n7_presat: forced fallback (precondition already satisfied): routine dispatches nothing, guarded continuation verifies with its scripted decisions counted, 1 accepted mutation; 3 per class, EXCLUSIVE
rows.N1: renamed target: routine stops at the failed precondition, 0 completion, not verified; 2 per class
rows.default_smoke: R2-10 BASE, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, no phase trace: verified, 1 completion; 5 per class

controls.pass_rules: R2-07c analyze_r2_07c.g4_pass / nw2_row and the R2-07d smoke rule, unchanged; plus Driver identity == B7 and E4 = 0

disposition.KEEP: H_CR passes for toggle and modal AND G0-G4 pass in both classes AND every control passes
disposition.REVISE: otherwise (with the measured numbers), in particular when non-regression fails

pilot: <= 10 trial records under the SHARED lock before this file (store 'pilot'): harness compatibility of the R2-07c runner with B7 and the B-07 stamped client; excluded from every result; reported
provider: TypeSafe cap 0: no provider key is forwarded; 0 attempts / 0 reached
claim_boundary: Scripted chooser and binary B7. The live-path reading covers only warm admitted invocations (0 decisions). Training and fallback provider costs come from R2-07e (binary R, LIVE_PROVIDER) and are cited as verdicts, never added to B7 numbers. No paired live S is claimed (BLOCKED on budget). The routine stays caller-side: no new service, registry, router or engine. No number is added to or ratioed across lanes or binaries, except the pre-registered SOURCE carry of B-08's per-document E(Wa) (same binary) inside the cold split, which cannot move the untested share
never: no amendment after the first measured trial; every trial kept
pilot_result: ran 16:05-16:13Z under the SHARED lock (store pilot, raw/pilot-* in the packet, excluded): 9/9 trial records valid on B7 (2 trainings + 2 admissions, admitted, authority scan clean; BASE, COMP, CRa, PC toggle; CRa modal); CRa 0 decisions, routes [compiled]; PC sleep 15.0002 ms after snapshot1; B-07 caller stamps present (13 per trial); B-05 decomposition consistency 0.0 ms and coverage 1.0 in 9/9; three chunks ended on the load gate (exit 75) before the pilot completed. Pilot timing was taken at loadavg up to 14 and is not a result
